intro: If you're heading to Khon Kaen and want somewhere good-looking with real design on a budget of a few thousand baht — not another business tower that all look the same — Nadee 10 Resort & Hotel is the name guests in Khon Kaen bring up most often for its looks and its service · a 4-star boutique design hotel in modern loft style, tucked into a residential neighbourhood in the city centre on Soi Lao Na Di 10 · what many people love is the design that blends art with clean, understated style, a pool with pool bar, free parking and an EV charger · 70 rooms and suites, from about ฿1,400/night · scores 8.8 from OTA reviews and once ranked #1 of 76 hotels in Khon Kaen on Tripadvisor.

body.html: Who Nadee 10 is for — to put it as briefly as possible, Nadee 10 Resort & Hotel is for people who want a "good-looking, design-led" stay in Khon Kaen without paying five-star prices · it isn't a tall business tower in the commercial district, and it isn't a destination resort that whisks you out of town · it's a 4-star boutique design hotel in modern loft style, tucked away in a quiet residential neighbourhood in the city centre on Soi Lao Na Di 10, Nai Mueang · its positioning is fairly clear: it plays on "design and service" at a price ordinary travellers can reach · the voice of real reviews lines up here — the people it suits are couples who want good atmosphere, families visiting relatives studying at Khon Kaen University, people in town for meetings or trade-show booths, and travellers who care more about cleanliness and how a room looks than about being next to a mall · what surprises many is the review record — on OTA platforms the hotel scores around 8.8, and more interestingly, on Tripadvisor it once ranked #1 of 76 hotels in Khon Kaen with a very high average score, which, for a 70-room hotel outside a big chain, is punching well above its price.

Location and getting around — Nadee 10 sits on Soi Lao Na Di 10, Lao Na Di Road, Nai Mueang, Mueang Khon Kaen, a residential neighbourhood in the city centre rather than a busy main road · the upside of a location like this is that it's quieter and safer than hotels on the main road, but the trade-off is the fairly narrow entrance soi, which some foreign reviews mention · distances are convenient: it's a short 5–10 min drive from Central Plaza Khon Kaen and Ton Tan Market, close to the Khon Kaen sports stadium and convention centre, and, importantly, within a drive of Bueng Kaen Nakhon, the lake in the city centre that's a popular spot for exercise and relaxing · Khon Kaen Airport (KKC) is about 10 km away, or roughly a 15–20 min drive · the honest advice is that this place suits people who have their own car or use a ride-hailing app more than those who want to walk everywhere, because the neighbourhood's walkability score isn't high — save the map pin for your driver, as the entrance soi isn't easy to find.

"The hotel looks new, very clean, and the rooms are beautifully designed for the price. The staff are friendly and helpful with everything, the bed is comfortable, and breakfast has plenty of variety. The best value stay we've had in Khon Kaen."

Room types and decor — Nadee 10 has about 70 rooms and suites in all, across several tiers from Standard Room and Deluxe Room to Garden Room and Suite · what sets it apart from similarly priced stays in Khon Kaen is the design — each room is decorated in a modern loft style mixed with art, using custom-designed materials and furniture rather than identical off-the-shelf rooms · every room has air conditioning, a flat-screen TV, a fridge and a bathroom with a water heater and good-quality toiletries · what reviews agree on most is the cleanliness and the comfortable bed — many use the phrase "so clean it feels brand new" and praise the pillows and mattress as just the right softness · the bathroom also draws praise, with reviews mentioning a strong-pressure shower and steady hot water, a detail many stays at this price in the city still don't get quite right · rooms are fairly spacious for the price, and those facing the garden or pool get a better atmosphere · one small note: it's a four-storey building with only a single lift, so if several people check in at once you may have to wait for it a little — anyone on an upper floor with heavy bags should keep that in mind.

Facilities and the pool — the highlight that makes Nadee 10 feel more like a resort than an ordinary city hotel is the pool with pool bar in a quiet setting · to be honest, the pool isn't a big lap pool like a destination resort's — it's a nicely sized pool for cooling off and chilling by the water rather than serious swimming, but in terms of atmosphere and cleanliness it's done well, and it's somewhere families can let the kids in without worry · beyond the pool there's free parking, a big deal for anyone driving in, and what many especially like is the EV charger, still not common at hotels in this price range · there's free high-speed Wi-Fi everywhere, laundry service, a 24-hour front desk, a shared computer, and a meeting room for seminars or get-togethers · small gardens around the hotel add some greenery and keep the atmosphere from feeling boxed-in like an all-concrete building · overall, on facilities, Nadee 10 brings more than the standard for a 4-star hotel in a secondary city like Khon Kaen.

Food and dining — the hotel's main restaurant is Nadee House, serving Thai and international food all-day-dining style, with a cafe corner and pool bar · breakfast is a buffet, served in the morning from around 06:30–10:30 · the review voice on breakfast leans positive, with many praising it as fresh, with plenty of choice across both Thai and Western dishes, and good value for what you pay · some reviews mention the cafe and pool bar staying open late, good for a light drink in the evening · the honest note is that, because the hotel is in a residential neighbourhood and not on a busy restaurant street, finding dinner outside the hotel may take a short drive — but it's not far, as Ton Tan Market and the restaurants around Central are a short drive away · one or two reviews say the restaurant menu doesn't have a huge range and some dishes are average — for example fried pork that was overcooked — which is normal for a mid-sized hotel restaurant · in short, Nadee 10's food isn't a reason to come in itself, but it's a good-enough add-on and convenient for breakfast.

Service — service is where Nadee 10 draws the densest praise in real reviews, and it's likely the main reason its overall score is high enough to rank near the top of the city · many staff are mentioned as friendly, attentive, cheerful and helpful, as if nothing is too much trouble · foreign reviews often use "super friendly" and "knowledgeable", reflecting a team that communicates and handles on-the-spot problems well · there's daily housekeeping, a 24-hour front desk, laundry service, and help with calling a car or recommending things to do · what impresses guests is the feeling of being genuinely looked after, not service by script · in fairness, in a hotel this size with a single lift, service can slow at times when lots of guests arrive at once — but overall, service is this place's clear strength.

The voice of real reviews (praise and gripes) — gathered from Tripadvisor, Agoda, Booking.com and Hotels.com, the picture is fairly consistent · On the praise side: rooms that are clean like new and beautifully designed, comfortable beds and pillows, a strong-pressure shower, friendly staff and excellent service, a varied and fresh breakfast, the pool and quiet atmosphere, free parking and an EV charger, and the sense of being the best value in the city — many reviews use the phrase "best value in Khon Kaen" · On the gripe side: the most-mentioned point is the residential location and narrow entrance soi, which makes it inconvenient for those who want to walk around or don't have a car · next is the single lift in a four-storey building, which can mean a wait when it's busy, and the restaurant menu that doesn't have a huge range, with some dishes being average · these gripes are about setting your expectations right from the start, rather than big problems that keep people from coming back — which the consistently high review scores reflect.

"Paid barely over a thousand a night and got a beautiful, clean room, a pool and free parking · the one downside is the fairly narrow entrance soi and nothing to walk to around it, so you have to drive out to eat — but at this price, it's hard to find anything better in Khon Kaen."

Price and value — the Standard room starts at about ฿1,400/night in normal periods, rising to around ฿2,000 over long weekends or city-event periods · larger rooms like the Deluxe and Garden Room run around ฿1,600–2,200, while a Suite goes up to around ฿2,500–3,500 depending on size and timing · the buffet breakfast can be added for around 250 baht per person, which many reviews call good value · compared with other design hotels or 4-star hotels in Khon Kaen, Nadee 10 feels strong value within the accessibly priced design-stay group, because you get decor that's nicer than the price, a high level of cleanliness, a pool, free parking and consistently praised service · if you weigh room looks, cleanliness and service over walking distance to a mall, the money you spend here comes back in full, and it's why so many reviews rate it among the top value picks in the city.

What to know before you book — a few things make for a smoother stay · one, save the map pin and the hotel's number before you travel, because it's in a soi in a residential neighbourhood with a fairly narrow entrance, and some drivers may not find it the first time · two, this place suits people with a car or ready to use a ride-hailing app, as there isn't much to walk to nearby — plan dinner or be ready to drive out to Central / Ton Tan Market · three, for the best atmosphere, ask for a room facing the garden or pool when you book · four, the building has a single lift, so if you have elderly travellers or heavy bags and don't want to wait, ask for a ground-floor room · five, during Khon Kaen's major events such as the silk fair, the annual festival, or Khon Kaen University graduation season, rooms fill fast and prices rise, so book ahead and pick free cancellation if your plans aren't set.

The verdict — from the full body of real reviews, Nadee 10 Resort & Hotel is the best fit for people who want a beautiful, design-led, clean stay with good service in Khon Kaen at a reachable price · the loft-style decor, high cleanliness, pool, free parking, EV charger and attentive staff make it good enough value that many reviews rate it among the top value picks in the city, and it once ranked #1 in Khon Kaen on Tripadvisor · if you're after a location within walking distance of malls and restaurants, or a big resort-style pool, this may not be the answer, and you should consider a hotel right in the commercial district instead · but for a trip where you want a beautiful, quiet, clean room with warm service on a budget of a few thousand baht — Nadee 10 meets that need just about perfectly, and it's why its name still comes up as one of Khon Kaen's best-value design stays.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Nadee 10 Resort & Hotel Khon Kaen

faq.q: Where is Nadee 10 Resort & Hotel, and what's nearby?
faq.a: It's on Soi Lao Na Di 10, Lao Na Di Road, Nai Mueang, Mueang Khon Kaen, in a residential neighbourhood in the city centre · about a 7 min drive from Central Plaza, around 5 min from Ton Tan Market, about 10 min from Bueng Kaen Nakhon, and about a 15–20 min drive from Khon Kaen Airport · the entrance soi is fairly narrow, so save the map pin before you travel.

faq.q: What does Nadee 10 cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start at about ฿1,400/night for a Standard room · there's a Deluxe Room around ฿1,700 · a Garden Room around ฿2,000 · and a Suite around ฿2,800 · the buffet breakfast can be added for around 250 baht per person · prices move with the season and city events, so always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Is there a pool, and what facilities are there?
faq.a: There's a pool with pool bar, nicely sized, in a quiet setting — better for cooling off and chilling than swimming for exercise · there's also the Nadee House restaurant, free parking, an EV charger, a meeting room, free Wi-Fi, laundry service, and a 24-hour front desk.

It's a great fit for people who want a beautiful, design-led, clean room with good service on a budget of a few thousand baht — couples, families visiting relatives studying at KKU, and people driving in for work · it's less suited to those who want to walk to malls and restaurants, or who want a big resort-style pool.

faq.q: What's the location and getting around like at Nadee 10?
faq.a: The hotel is in a quiet residential neighbourhood with a fairly narrow entrance soi, and there isn't much to walk to around it · it suits people with a car or ready to use a ride-hailing app · the upside is that it's quieter and safer than hotels on the main road, and still a short drive from Central, Ton Tan Market and Bueng Kaen Nakhon.

faq.q: How are Nadee 10's reviews, and is there anything to know?
faq.a: Most reviews are very positive, praising the cleanliness, the room design, the friendly service and the value · the hotel scores around 8.8 on OTAs and once ranked #1 of 76 hotels in Khon Kaen on Tripadvisor · what to know: the entrance soi is narrow, the four-storey building has a single lift, and the restaurant menu doesn't have a huge range.
